title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (13/20): The Caregiver Helps Grandma with Her Medicine
note_en: 多亏了……才…… means "thanks to X, (only then) Y": 多亏了护工耐心的照顾，她才能把身体照顾得这么好 "Thanks to the caregiver's patient care, she's been able to stay in such good health." The 才 in the second half stresses that the good result depends on what 多亏了 introduces; English simply says "thanks to."
